title: Megurine Luka — Doing Things My Own Way〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder what they're doing sitting together like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But they don't seem to be talking or anything...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I haven't really had a chance to talk to them yet either, have I?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Mafuyu, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I joined you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you. If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you, Mafuyu. Do you know why I appeared in this SEKAI all the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku said something about me changing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then you do know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You, the one whose feelings created this SEKAI, have been changing, and is being reflected here in certain ways.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As a result, we are able to exist here alongside Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, do you sense or feel anything when you talk to me like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do I feel?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It doesn't have to be me either. Miku, MEIKO and Rin too. How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You tried to think about it but hesitated there for a moment.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I saw it just now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're like Ena...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In what way?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You say that I do things that I don't realize I'm doing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? And how do you feel about that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You think I'm annoying, obnoxious and someone you want nothing to do with, no? See, you are feeling something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I take that back. I think you're more like Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? How's that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because of the way you explained what I might be feeling and why.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you figure out something...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not really. Just that she really just doesn't know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Miku mentioned that MEIKO was wandering around here as if she were looking for something...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That may be because Mafuyu hasn't been able to process what she's feeling quite yet.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This SEKAI is no longer empty...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this SEKAI itself is not all that different from how it originally was. It's still dark, quite and populated by a countable number of people...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What do you suppose this means?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What that means...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A SEKAI is supposed to reflect how a person is feeling. There has to be a reason as to why this place is the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know what that is...
How would I possibly know such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And that's okay for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, I will very likely keep asking you these questions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why if something bothers you or catches your attention, I want you to try to remember and focus on that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Because as long as you don't, nothing will actually change.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good.
Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And thank you for giving me this opportunity as well, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll see you later...
